goddesses.name: Lady Liberty
goddesses.obtain: Tap Football
goddesses.title: Lady Liberty
goddesses.bio: She believes everyone has their own way of joining in, some wave flags, some beat drums, and some simply sing along in a quiet voice. But as long as they're willing to raise their voice, she'll catch that little spark of courage and stir it into a roaring wave across the stands.

goddesses.name: Bastet
goddesses.obtain: Ring Toss #3; back in Ring Toss #5
goddesses.title: Cat Goddess
goddesses.bio: In an Egyptian bazaar bathed in twilight, a barefoot girl spins among the cats at her feet. Her skirt brushes the edges of the market stalls, and the instrument in her hands rings softly with the rhythm. The cats leap and weave around her, as if she herself were a flowing melody. She has no wish to display divine power, she simply speaks to living creatures through dance, and without question, they answer in kind.

goddesses.name: Hela
goddesses.obtain: Ring Toss #2; back in Ring Toss #4
goddesses.title: Queen of the Underworld
goddesses.bio: She is not yet the ruler of the Underworld, nor seated upon the throne of the dead. Yet now and then, under the cloak of night, a shadow sweeps across the clocktower's spire. Those who prey upon the meek, wealthy lords, greedy lenders, or street tyrants in the alleys, often meet a silent end before dawn.

goddesses.name: Ixchel
goddesses.affinity: Grand Voyage city dividends +2%. All-hero ATK/HP +3%.
goddesses.obtain: Grand Voyage unlock event, at city level 20; back in Ring Toss #5
goddesses.title: Moon Goddess
goddesses.bio: She is a girl raised in the jungle who loves to appear on bright moonlit nights. If there is anything unusual about her, it is her knack for bringing rain wherever she goes.

goddesses.name: Medusa
goddesses.obtain: Ring Toss #1; back in Ring Toss #4
goddesses.title: Gorgon
goddesses.bio: Where did the rumor that anyone who sees her turns to stone come from? Medusa doesn't know, nor does she care. This artist, who enjoys capturing people's moments of terror in stone, turns her carving knife while pondering; perhaps her next piece needs some new inspiration.

goddesses.name: Moirai
goddesses.obtain: Goddess Theater unlock event, at city level 18; back in Ring Toss #4
goddesses.title: Goddess of Fate
goddesses.bio: The spinning wheel untangles the threads, the scissors define their measure, and the spindle gathers them all. With patterns and measures in hand, they weave the perfect costume, once finished, can never be altered.

goddesses.name: Muse
goddesses.affinity: Muse Coin +2% in Museion. All-hero ATK/HP +3%.
goddesses.obtain: Museion unlock event, at city level 18 with Sapientium 3; back in Ring Toss #4
goddesses.title: Goddess of Art
goddesses.bio: They are never formally listed in the pantheon, nor crowned with the title Source of Inspiration. They are ordinary women — village performers, wandering poets, singers by the river — yet they can, without intending to, spark astonishing ideas in others.

goddesses.name: Athena
goddesses.obtain: VIP 4
goddesses.title: Goddess of Wisdom
goddesses.bio: She is not yet the embodiment of wisdom, but a young apprentice in the library who loves to ask questions. She sits alone under the lamplight, poring over ancient scrolls, surrounded by bronze helmets and weapon models. The rustle of turning pages is the first clang of the Aegis yet to be forged.

goddesses.name: Isis
goddesses.obtain: Egypt unlock event, at city level 26
goddesses.title: Goddess of Magic
goddesses.bio: The Nile can wash away everything upon the earth, yet it cannot erase the scars etched into bone. What she must do is piece together, among the remains, the truth the dead never had the chance to tell.

goddesses.name: Calypso
goddesses.obtain: Ring Toss, reported as the sixth
goddesses.title: Goddess of the Sea
goddesses.bio: People say the sea favors her, but she knows it favors no one. It brings the same wind and waves to everyone. What matters is who can grit their teeth and make it, ship and all, back to shore.

goddesses.name: Lilith
goddesses.obtain: Not confirmed yet
goddesses.title: Occult Healer
goddesses.bio: Prescriptions have strict dosage standards; her rules do not. No one can predict how Lilith will charge today, just as no one knows what color her next medicine will be. The one thing you can count on is that she never plays with patients—except with the rich wallets.

goddesses.name: Brunhild
goddesses.obtain: Finish Campaign 60-6
goddesses.title: Valkyrie
goddesses.bio: Flames resemble a burning wreath, softly singing around her throne. Brunhild closes her eyes, and what echoes in her dreams isn't Odin's threats, but the faint glimmer she once safeguarded for humanity on the battlefield. Stripped of her divinity, she sleeps, waiting for the destined one to awaken her.

goddesses.name: Venus
goddesses.obtain: First top-up, $2.50
goddesses.title: God of Love and Beauty
goddesses.bio: She is not yet born from the waves and foam, but a fisher girl washing clothes alone by the sea. People say her smile makes fish leap ashore and sends boats sailing with the wind. She knows nothing of the destiny called the Goddess of Love, only how to practice her smile at the river mouth, gazing at her own reflection. Yet the tide has already begun to swirl quietly around her.

goddesses.name: Vivian
goddesses.affinity: Mystic Tower sweep rewards +6%. Shieldman ATK/HP +6%.
goddesses.obtain: Reach level 40 in the Mystic Tower
goddesses.title: Lake Fairy
goddesses.bio: Though Vivian has yet to become the legendary Lady of the Lake, the waters now part for her, and the morning mist entwines her skirt. She offers the sword to destiny, gently entrusting herself to an uncertain future. With each gaze, she silently chooses who will be favored by fate and who will be forgotten at the lake's bottom.

goddesses.name: Artemis
goddesses.affinity: Crown Glory Honor Fortune +2%. Archer ATK/HP +6%.
goddesses.obtain: Fight 50 battles in Knights’ Ascent
goddesses.title: Goddess of the Hunt
goddesses.bio: The owners of the archery stalls hated Artemis, who hit every shot. They tried to tamper with the bows and arrows, adjusting the angle of the pottery jars, but they never succeeded in stopping her from walking away with the grand prize. What they didn't know was that behind every pottery jar that fell with the sound of a released bowstring, a black dog head grinning at its master secretly retracted.

goddesses.name: Fortuna
goddesses.obtain: Unlock the Medieval Age
goddesses.title: Goddess of Fortune
goddesses.bio: Some say she is a village girl who wandered into the city; others claim she is an exiled noble. But no one truly knows that her name is already inscribed on the list of the Gods. Fortuna dances between dice cups and roulette wheels, every victory drawing her closer to divinity. And she herself? She only cares about the next drink, the next win.

goddesses.name: Freya
goddesses.affinity: Glory Arena damage dealt +5%. Pikeman ATK/HP +6%.
goddesses.obtain: 9,000 points in Grand Launch Fest, during the seven-day server launch
goddesses.title: God of Love and War
goddesses.bio: Who could have predicted that the one crying in her arms today would be Thor, the future wielder of thunder? Who could foresee that the slyly smiling Loki beside him would become the fire-making to upend the order of realms? Freya has yet to fully embrace her divine fate; she cradles all nascent epics into the world with a tender heart, allowing sunlight and breeze to gently crown them.

goddesses.name: Hera
goddesses.affinity: Northern Enemy ally damage reduction +5%. Cavalry ATK/HP +6%.
goddesses.obtain: Thought to come with a civilisation age
goddesses.title: Queen
goddesses.bio: The defendant feared her authority, and the plaintiff thanked her for her protection, yet she merely sat on the judgment seat, shattering all lies within vows with her gavel. In her court, love, or the lack thereof, was never the focus; whether one remained faithful to the vows spoken before the priest was the criterion that swayed her gavel.

goddesses.name: Eve
goddesses.obtain: Complete five patrols in total
goddesses.title: Primeval Lady
goddesses.bio: In the lush depths of Eden, an innocent girl locks eyes with a snake in the treetops. Instead of retreating, she's drawn in by its whispers. Her fingertip trembles as it points to the forbidden fruit, debating her emerging divinity. At this moment, the seeds of future calamity and civilization are quietly sown.

goddesses.name: Hestia
goddesses.obtain: Knowledge (Advisors) level 3
goddesses.title: Goddess of the Hearth
goddesses.bio: At this moment, Hestia has yet to firmly sit upon her divine throne; she is just a gentle maiden tending the hearth at the town center. She hands the fire-making to the people, using warmth to dispel the cold of night. She believes unity and home are the true essence of civilization, whispering dreams of future societies by the bonfire.

goddesses.name: Nike
goddesses.affinity: 4% chance for +1 Norman Oak in Glory Arena. Pikeman ATK/HP +6%.
goddesses.obtain: Fight 40 times in Glory Arena
goddesses.title: Goddess of Victory
goddesses.bio: Amidst thunderous cheers, Nike approached the glory-laden warrior. She had yet to become the supreme goddess of victory, so her laurel was more a gesture of understanding and solace. She gently circled the warrior's temples with laurel leaves, lending them divinity for a fleeting moment, allowing their heartbeat to sync with the rhythm of Olympus.

goddesses.name: Demeter
goddesses.affinity: Production building upgrade cost −5%. Shieldman ATK/HP +6%.
goddesses.obtain: Unlock the Classical Age
goddesses.title: Goddess of Harvest
goddesses.bio: Demeter holds a bundle of heavy wheat, like the friendly girl from the neighboring village, chatting and laughing with farmers on the field paths. At this moment, she is still just a simple farm girl, watching the crops with bright eyes. Yet, unbeknownst to her, tiny lights are quietly rising from the wheat stalks, ensuring this golden field will no longer wither due to natural disasters.
